issue.title: masking: a rerank's record is filed as "embeddings"
issue.body:
## Problem

With `redact: true`, a `/v1/rerank` request *is* masked — that part is right — but the record it leaves behind says `what: "embeddings"`. So Settings › Privacy and the masking JSONL can't tell a rerank from an embeddings call. Every retrieval record reads as embeddings.

This matters for auditing: rerank is the endpoint that carries whole documents (`documents: [...]`), while embeddings carries short strings. When the question is "what left this machine, and how much of it", the two are not the same thing and should not share a label.

## Cause

`serveRetrieval` (`internal/gateway/embeddings.go`) builds the record's `what` from the request type, not from the operation it was routed for:

```go
what := "embeddings"
if _, audio := req.(*audioForm); audio {
    what = "audio"
}
// the record names the try that had it last, not the first
// planned (noteMaskedUntil)
_, noted := noteMaskedUntil(r, what, hits, sent, 0, tries[0].p.ID, asked)
```

The `operation` the handler was built with is already in scope and already correct — `gateway.go` registers:

```go
mux.HandleFunc("POST /v1/embeddings", s.retrieve("/embeddings", "embeddings"))
mux.HandleFunc("POST /v1/rerank", s.retrieve("/rerank", "rerank"))
```

and `serveRetrieval` already passes it to the usage ledger (`embeddings.go:240`, `usage.Record{Operation: operation, ...}`), where a rerank is correctly counted as `rerank`. It just never reaches the mask record.

The set of `what` values elsewhere is `chat`, `search`, `audio`, `decide` — each named for what it is. `rerank` is the one that has no name of its own.

## Repro

Needs a provider whose model answers `/rerank`. I could not reproduce on my own gateway: my providers serve embeddings and decision models only, so `/v1/rerank` has nothing to route to and never gets as far as masking. The path is a single assignment, though — a rerank that masks anything at all writes `what: "embeddings"`.

Expected: a rerank's record says `rerank`, as its usage row does.
Actual: it says `embeddings`.

## Fix

```go
what := operation
if _, audio := req.(*audioForm); audio {
    what = "audio"
}
```

`operation` is `"embeddings"` or `"rerank"` from the route, so both retrieval endpoints keep a label that matches what they are, and audio keeps its own. A test that sends a rerank body with a secret and asserts the record's `What` would pin it.

comments.body:
Here is a fix on a fork branch. This repo doesn't take PRs (README), so I'm leaving a patch for `git am`.

**Cause:** `serveRetrieval` (`internal/gateway/embeddings.go`) hard-coded `what := "embeddings"` for every retrieval path when recording a masked request. `/v1/rerank` is registered with operation `"rerank"` and the usage ledger already uses that operation, but the mask record did not — so Settings → Privacy and the masking JSONL filed a redacted rerank as embeddings.

**Change:** `what := operation`, with the existing audio override kept. Embeddings stay `"embeddings"`; rerank becomes `"rerank"`.

**Test** (`TestRerankMaskRecordIsRerank` in `internal/gateway/embeddings_test.go`). With the old `embeddings.go` it fails:

```
--- FAIL: TestRerankMaskRecordIsRerank (0.01s)
    embeddings_test.go:240: what = "embeddings", want rerank
```

With the fix, the test passes.

**Checks** (Go on linux/amd64, temporary HOME with GOPATH/GOMODCACHE/GOCACHE pinned):
- `gofmt -l` on the changed files: no output
- `GOOS=linux go vet -tags nogui ./...`, `GOOS=windows go vet ./...`: pass (or were re-run after the suite)
- `GOOS=linux go build -tags nogui`, `GOOS=windows go build`: pass when pkg-config is not required for those targets
- Plain `go vet ./...` / `go build` (no tags): 没跑 successfully — this box has no GTK/WebKit/`pkg-config` for the GUI packages
- `go test -tags nogui -run TestRerankMaskRecordIsRerank ./internal/gateway/`: pass; fails as above without the fix
- `go test -tags nogui ./...`: 没跑 clean — several packages fail in this sandbox the same way on unmodified main (e.g. `davsync` TeraCloud sync, `tui` subscription fetch, agent install-path probes, WSL cold place). Not attributed to this change.
- GUI / Playwright: 没跑 (no GUI change)

Commit `f09ce97` on top of `f8cd964`:
https://github.com/yetone/magpie/compare/main...ump45nose:magpie:fix/3925-rerank-mask-what

`git format-patch --no-signature --full-index --stdout f8cd964..f09ce97 | sha256sum` is `b2e50056bbf27fe51ddcbbda045c9bcb95a41fed593f676b30596d0f274527d1`.

<details>
<summary>format-patch</summary>

```diff
From f09ce973960c3abd0d0e7fa1d22aa94e39f4dce9 Mon Sep 17 00:00:00 2001
From: ump45nose <ump45nose@users.noreply.github.com>
Date: Wed, 28 Oct 2026 01:32:56 +0800
Subject: [PATCH] gateway: a masked rerank's record says "rerank", not
 "embeddings"
MIME-Version: 1.0
Content-Type: text/plain; charset=UTF-8
Content-Transfer-Encoding: 8bit

serveRetrieval hard-coded the mask record's what as "embeddings" for
every retrieval path, so a /v1/rerank that redacted documents was filed
under the same label as embeddings. Settings → Privacy and the masking
JSONL could not tell them apart. The usage ledger already used the
route's operation; the mask record now does too (audio stays "audio").

Fixes #3925 (patch for maintainer; this repo doesn't take PRs).
---
 internal/gateway/embeddings.go      |  2 +-
 internal/gateway/embeddings_test.go | 24 ++++++++++++++++++++++++
 2 files changed, 25 insertions(+), 1 deletion(-)

diff --git a/internal/gateway/embeddings.go b/internal/gateway/embeddings.go
index 71bb8b2acc7fd82fc0014fd7cc4b34e7f4137b99..26cac0d9a7b175ea4958f3f14e34d8aac211f46d 100644
--- a/internal/gateway/embeddings.go
+++ b/internal/gateway/embeddings.go
@@ -189,7 +189,7 @@ func (s *Server) serveRetrieval(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request, path, op
 			s.record(call)
 			return
 		}
-		what := "embeddings"
+		what := operation
 		if _, audio := req.(*audioForm); audio {
 			what = "audio"
 		}
diff --git a/internal/gateway/embeddings_test.go b/internal/gateway/embeddings_test.go
index 5155d080562ab55e9324f0666de9ee373dd31961..0bccfc23201a5bb1c9c3e54df3a85d3e43657f27 100644
--- a/internal/gateway/embeddings_test.go
+++ b/internal/gateway/embeddings_test.go
@@ -11,6 +11,7 @@ import (
 	"testing"
 	"time"
 
+	"github.com/yetone/magpie/internal/maskrec"
 	"github.com/yetone/magpie/internal/provider"
 	"github.com/yetone/magpie/internal/settings"
 	"github.com/yetone/magpie/internal/usage"
@@ -217,6 +218,29 @@ func TestRetrievalRedacts(t *testing.T) {
 	}
 }
 
+// #3925: a masked /v1/rerank record is filed as "rerank", not "embeddings".
+// serveRetrieval used to hard-code what := "embeddings" for every retrieval
+// path; the usage ledger already had the route's operation.
+func TestRerankMaskRecordIsRerank(t *testing.T) {
+	s, _ := shelved(t)
+	if err := settings.Save(settings.Settings{Redact: true}); err != nil {
+		t.Fatal(err)
+	}
+	secret := "sk-ant-api03-" + strings.Repeat("Ab3x", 20)
+	before, _ := maskrec.List(0, 1, maskrec.Filter{})
+	code, raw := postRetrieval(t, s, "/v1/rerank", `{"model":"lib/rerank-1","query":"q","documents":["`+secret+`","b"],"return_documents":true}`)
+	if code != 200 {
+		t.Fatalf("%d %s", code, raw)
+	}
+	rs, _ := maskrec.List(0, 1, maskrec.Filter{})
+	if len(rs) != 1 || (len(before) == 1 && rs[0].Key == before[0].Key) {
+		t.Fatalf("nothing recorded: %+v", rs)
+	}
+	if rs[0].What != "rerank" {
+		t.Fatalf("what = %q, want rerank (record: %+v)", rs[0].What, rs[0])
+	}
+}
+
 // #773: a routing group's members are tried in turn for embeddings and
 // rerank as for a chat: one out of quota (429) or one without the API
 // (404) passes the request to the next, and when all fail the last one's
```

</details>

AI assistance disclosure: an AI coding assistant helped write this fix, the test and this comment. I reviewed the change and ran the checks listed above.

Confirmed, and fixed on a fork branch.

`serveRetrieval` built the masking record's `what` from the request type alone — `"embeddings"`, or `"audio"` for a transcript — never from the operation the handler was registered for. That operation was already in scope and already reached the usage ledger, so the record now names it: `/v1/rerank` records `what: "rerank"`, the embeddings route keeps `what: "embeddings"`, and a multipart transcript still records `"audio"`.

Branch: [`fix/3925-rerank-record-name`](https://github.com/skygunner/magpie/tree/fix/3925-rerank-record-name), commit [`5e1ea3cf`](https://github.com/skygunner/magpie/commit/5e1ea3cf634b3880eeaf20cf7b1a6639124d6673), based on `upstream/main` `f8cd964a`.

Test: `TestRetrievalRecordNamesItsOperation` (`internal/gateway`) posts a redacted rerank whose documents carry a secret and asserts the record it leaves is `what:"rerank"` — red on the unmodified code (`What:embeddings`), green with the branch. `go build ./...`, `gofmt -l internal/gateway` and `go vet ./internal/gateway/` are clean, and the package run's only failures are the five that are red on unmodified `upstream/main` on this machine (`TestMarshalRawIsEncodingJSON`, `FuzzMarshalRaw/seed#7`, `TestServeWSLListensBesideLoopback`, `TestCodexFittedImagesPastTheBudget` — #3045 — and `TestClaudeClientCacheAbsentUnchanged`, re-run three times on a clean tree).

It is a fork branch for review, not a claim on the issue.

Withdrawing this one: ump45nose posted a `git am` patch for it at 17:33, three minutes before my comment at 17:37, so my branch duplicates their fix. The branch `fix/3925-...` stays as a reference only; their patch is the one to review.
